name: away_with_active_natvent_transition
description: Warm day, whole-house fan configured: nat-vent running at home. User leaves (occupancy_away) at 15:00. Production does not exit nat-vent on the occupancy transition; the away setpoint write is blocked while the whole-house fan runs (household rule 2) and nat-vent keeps running. There is no explicit nat-vent exit event on occupancy transition. The configured fan is the opt-in for nat-vent (Issue #1140); the no-fan pause is covered by the scenarios #1140 added.
notes: Production handle_occupancy_away() does NOT deactivate nat-vent. It only attempts the setpoint change (refused while the whole-house fan runs, rule 2).
Nat-vent continues until a natural exit condition fires: outdoor rises, comfort floor hit, threshold exceeded.
This scenario verifies: (1) the away setback write is refused while the whole-house fan runs (rule 2), (2) nat-vent state is NOT prematurely exited.
The assertion that nat-vent is still active after away transition documents production behavior.

events.note: Warm-day classification at home (hvac_mode left to classifier.py, which derives off for a warm day)
Window opens: nat-vent activates (outdoor 65F < indoor 73.5F, below threshold 77F)
User leaves. Production: only setpoint changes to setback_cool. Nat-vent continues.

assertions.reason: Window opens with outdoor 65F < indoor 73.5F, indoor > comfort_heat 70F, outdoor under the 77F threshold and a whole-house fan configured (the opt-in for nat-vent, Issue #1140): nat-vent activates.

Away transition at 15:00 while the whole-house fan is running nat-vent: the setback_cool=79F write is blocked because the whole-house fan and HVAC never run together (household rule 2); production does not exit nat-vent on occupancy change.

After the away transition the nat-vent session flag must still be True: handle_occupancy_away() leaves nat-vent running and only the (blocked) setpoint write is affected. Reads the live engine _natural_vent_active.

verdict.summary: Away transition does not exit nat-vent; the setback write is refused while the whole-house fan runs (production behavior)
verdict.observed_behavior: occupancy_away fires -> hvac_write_blocked_whf_active (the setback_cool 79F write is refused while the whole-house fan runs, rule 2); nat-vent flag remains active
verdict.expected_behavior: Leaving home while nat-vent is active: the setpoint change is deferred by rule 2 and nat-vent is not exited. No explicit nat-vent exit event. Nat-vent exits naturally when outdoor conditions change.
